title: 2023 — #01 — Shibby Live and Uncut (Podcast #01)
description: Welcome to the first instalment in my brand new "Podcast" series. Every month I try to do a live recording, and these podcasts are a way for you to listen in on those experiences at your own leisure. It'll be laid back, relaxed and you'll get to hear me go through the process of voicing yet-to-be released files in their raw and naked form, before they are cut out, to make the audios you all know and love. (There may still be small edits made; eg. removal of long sections of dead-air). Recording DateThis live recording took place on the 23rd of February in 2023.
author: Mistress Shibby
